_comment: Editable style knobs. Yours to tune; nothing machine-writes this file. Weights scale terms of the action score and are 0.0-4.0; biases are additive and may be negative, -2.0 to 2.0. River Scholar is the neutral reference every specialist is measured against, so every weight here is 1.0 and every bias is 0.0 by design — change these and you move the baseline itself.
name: River Scholar
